searchText: I've drafted a PR on PeerDAS readiness here: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/pull/1314 **ACDC #151 in ~15 mins!** Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1280 Stream: https://www.youtube.com/live/RMXhEnc4PZk Zoom: https://ethereumfoundation.zoom.us/j/83703239965?pwd=VnjQjZ06LIaCzOjmyY1Jllt0LoTpvK.1 Published Reth view on Fusaka:https://www.paradigm.xyz/2025/02/what-comes-after-ethereums-pectra-hard-fork.
